script.title: How Cult.fit Plans to Hit ₹10,000 Cr #shorts

segments.text: Your local Cult gym cannot make ten thousand crores.
Yet, Cult.fit is targeting that exact milestone.
Here is the math: group classes cap out at thirty people per batch.
Between sky-high metro rent and trainer salaries, physical gym centers hit a ceiling fast.
So Cult flipped the playbook from selling sweat to selling sportswear.
Apparels and gear scale across tier-two cities online without paying massive real estate deposits.
Add gym franchises, and a fitness club turns into a retail juggernaut.
